title: Says “Lambada”
description: Nenavath Mohan, a Lambadi speaker, says "Lambada" (Lambadi). The clip is cut from his conversation with Meghavath Sathish, also a Lambadi speaker. They talk about Aadhaar, India's digital ID, and their community's life in a village in Vikarabad district, Telangana, India. Subhashish Panigrahi, a Baleswari Odia speaker, interviewed them in Hyderabad, Telangana, on 4 September 2019 for his documentary MarginalizedAadhaar. Panigrahi partly subtitled the interview in Hindi on location from a word-for-word translation by Meghavath and Nenavath, and Nenavath later translated and reviewed the subtitles. Panigrahi edited the footage, some of which was used in the film, translated the subtitles into English and published them under the OpenSpeaks Archives project in 2026.
